interest_cents.description: 1099-INT box 1, taxable interest (excluding box 3 — the form's own instruction). Optional: a savings-bond-only form leaves it blank; absent is computed as zero and stated in the response. Never negative.

government_interest_cents.description: 1099-INT box 3, interest on U.S. Savings Bonds and Treasury obligations — taxable federally and excluded from box 1. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.

tax_exempt_interest_cents.description: 1099-INT box 8, tax-exempt interest. Optional; absent is computed as zero and stated. Never negative.

federal_withholding_cents.description: 1099-INT box 4, federal income tax withheld. Optional — blank is an ordinary state of the box; absent is computed as zero and stated. Reaches Form 1040 line 25b, inside 25d. Never negative.

early_withdrawal_penalty_cents.description: 1099-INT box 2, early withdrawal penalty. Optional; absent is none. Reaches Schedule 1 line 18, an adjustment to income, and so AGI. Never negative.

private_activity_bond_interest_cents.description: 1099-INT box 9, specified private activity bond interest — the part of box 8 that is a Form 6251 preference (the alternative minimum tax). Optional; absent is none. Never negative.

market_discount_cents.description: 1099-INT box 10, market discount. Optional; absent is none. Added to taxable interest. Never negative.

bond_premium_cents.description: 1099-INT box 11, bond premium (on a taxable bond other than a Treasury obligation). Optional; absent is none. Reduces the box 1 interest it is allocable to. Never negative.

treasury_bond_premium_cents.description: 1099-INT box 12, bond premium on Treasury obligations. Optional; absent is none. Reduces the box 3 interest. Never negative.

tax_exempt_bond_premium_cents.description: 1099-INT box 13, bond premium on a tax-exempt bond. Optional; absent is none. Reduces the box 8 tax-exempt interest (Form 1040 line 2a), which the Social Security benefits worksheet reads. Never negative.
